checks: Local-only editor saves body, colour, label, pin and reminder atomically through real Rust/SQLite with zero HTTP requests
Escape and close require an explicit dirty-draft decision; discard does not save
Explicit first connection uploads the local card and its remapped reminder once; the real fake allocates Tack's Build-label bui reference
Two actual HTTP clients create text conflicts; both UI resolutions use frozen guards, survive acknowledgement and retain the losing body in note_revisions
History is readable in the editor; reminder edits round trip through the fake and reload; DB/logs contain neither synthetic password nor recovery code
Parsed Enter capture writes one card/reminder atomically, replays without duplication and receives its reference through the real fake sync
Shift+Enter opens an unsaved checklist; full editor creates it once with stable item identity, parsed labels/priority, colour and body
Unlabelled UI capture receives a real server tck-N; editing/checking/recolouring/labelling/pinning preserves unknown nested card and checklist fields after HTTP acknowledgement
Archive, trash and restore UI actions persist and round trip through the owned fake, including archived-card editor navigation
Sticky UI autosaves via guarded production SQLite/outbox/Service/HTTP; main editor reads the same card and unknown fields survive (window lifecycle remains a test seam)
Native HTML5 import matches the pinned Tack DOMParser walk for nested folders, dates, entities and bookmarklet rejection, with Nabbit root-label filtering
New bookmark editor uses Save link, resolves its automatic title through the production metadata service and preserves the address
Bounded cookie-free metadata GET prefers OG title; scoped save preserves the original address and both request replay and normalized duplicate capture return one card

Import sheet reads five isolated browser profiles plus an injected HTML picker, displays exact allowlisted files, defaults Later/folder labels/dedupe, imports 56 dated links once and syncs in at most 50 mutations per request
Links UI searches domains, filters folder labels and applies guarded bulk labels/archive; Open all and Copy reach recording providers without opening browsers or touching the OS clipboard
One durable undo group trashes all 56 imported links through real sync, preserves subsequent labels/archive and is idempotent
Durable capture navigation is consumed once after reload; local-only Enter capture persists with zero additional fake HTTP calls
Live Rust push events reach the browser without a polling timer; no unknown IPC or external network
scope: Actual browser UI, typed frontend API, test-only IPC forwarding bridge, production Rust Service/client/SQLite and in-process Rust fake. HTTPS .invalid alias maps to the owned loopback fake only in the test bridge. No native Tauri IPC or OS clipboard claim.
